Messages.Author: AgentZero
Messages.Body:
* Skin of Steel - If you do a strike that does damage to all
vamps/minions in combat, can you use Skin of Steel to
prevent the damage your receive from your own strike?
I say no, but I'd like to get confirmation.

* Undead Persistance -
Card Text:
Only usable when this vampire should go into torpor.
Optional press, and this vampire will not go into torpor
until combat ends or 3 rounds of combat pass with no
cards played.

I know that this doesn't work like a Trap (although, it
looks like it *should*) because the wording is there.
So my question is this: how could the second requirement
ever be fulfilled? How could 3 rounds pass with no
cards played? Is this just a case of very poor wording?

a0

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
AgentZero wrote:
>
> * Skin of Steel - If you do a strike that does damage to all
> vamps/minions in combat, can you use Skin of Steel to
> prevent the damage your receive from your own strike?
> I say no, but I'd like to get confirmation.

You mean like the self-damaging bomb? No. Can't use a Leather Jacket
either.

> * Undead Persistance -
> Card Text:
> Only usable when this vampire should go into torpor.
> Optional press, and this vampire will not go into torpor
> until combat ends or 3 rounds of combat pass with no
> cards played.
>
> I know that this doesn't work like a Trap (although, it
> looks like it *should*) because the wording is there.
> So my question is this: how could the second requirement
> ever be fulfilled? How could 3 rounds pass with no
> cards played? Is this just a case of very poor wording?

You just need to come up with the presses from another source. If you
play a card to press every round, you'll never fulfill the requirement
for ending the combat. If it is used in combination with a Trap, the
second requirement could be met. (1 Press from UP, and then 3 Presses
from Trap. There are also cardless Presses like mob connections)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"AgentZero" <agen...@my-dejanews.com> wrote:
> * Skin of Steel - If you do a strike that does damage to all
> vamps/minions in combat, can you use Skin of Steel to
> prevent the damage your receive from your own strike?
> I say no, but I'd like to get confirmation.

* "Damage from a strike" only includes damage done to the opposing
target. Side effect damage is not counted as "damage from a strike".
Therefore, self-inflicted damage from Zip Gun, Grenade, Burst of
Sunlight, Body of Sun, etc. is side effect damage and is not
preventable by "prevent damage from a strike" effects like Skin of
Steel, Leather Jacket, etc. [LSJ 970108]

> * Undead Persistance -
> Card Text:
> Only usable when this vampire should go into torpor.
> Optional press, and this vampire will not go into torpor
> until combat ends or 3 rounds of combat pass with no
> cards played.
>
> I know that this doesn't work like a Trap (although, it
> looks like it *should*) because the wording is there.
> So my question is this: how could the second requirement
> ever be fulfilled? How could 3 rounds pass with no
> cards played? Is this just a case of very poor wording?

There could be a trap. Or the minions could be using presses from
cards in play: Hawg, Mob Connections, Shadow of the Beast, etc.
and/or from cards played before the combat: Fast Reaction,
Rat's Warning, etc.
